fields.label: Manage cursor settings
fields.description: Synchronize this cursor theme and size across the Aqueous session.

fields.label: Cursor theme
fields.description: Installed XCursor theme used by Aqueous and desktop applications.

fields.label: Cursor size
fields.description: Base cursor size in pixels before output scaling.

fields.label: Desktop font
fields.description: Font family synchronized across Noctalia, GTK, qt5ct, and qt6ct.

fields.label: Desktop font face
fields.description: Installed face within the selected family. Empty uses the toolkit's automatic match.

fields.label: Desktop font weight
fields.description: Portable font weight selected with the installed face.

fields.label: Desktop font slant
fields.description: Portable slant selected with the installed face.

fields.label: Desktop font width
fields.description: Portable width selected with the installed face.

fields.label: Desktop font size
fields.description: Point size for toolkit UI text. Noctalia maps 12 pt to its default text scale.

fields.label: Fullscreen hides bar
fields.description: Let fullscreen windows use the bar area.

fields.label: Blur passes
fields.description: Higher values increase blur and GPU cost.

fields.label: Blur noise
fields.description: Stable screen-space noise added to the blurred backdrop.

fields.label: Blur contrast
fields.description: Contrast applied to the blurred backdrop; 1 is neutral.

fields.label: Blur brightness
fields.description: Brightness applied to the blurred backdrop; 1 is neutral.

fields.label: Blur vibrancy
fields.description: Saturation boost applied to blurred colors.

fields.label: Dark-area vibrancy
fields.description: How strongly vibrancy affects dark blurred colors.

fields.label: Window opacity
fields.description: Stable opacity when focus sensitivity is disabled.

fields.label: Focus-sensitive opacity
fields.description: Use separate focused and unfocused values.

fields.label: System bell
fields.description: Visual feedback, custom sound, both, or off.

fields.label: Bell sound file
fields.description: WAV or supported Ogg file; absolute or relative to wm.toml. Empty disables audio; playback is capped at 2 seconds.

fields.label: Bell volume
fields.description: Bell stream volume; zero is silent. Does not change system volume.

fields.label: Default layout
fields.description: Layout used without a more specific mapping.

fields.label: Outer gaps
fields.description: Pixels between placements and the usable output edge.

fields.label: Master ratio
fields.description: Share of the output assigned to the master area.

fields.label: Master count
fields.description: Number of windows in the master area.

fields.label: Prefer server decorations
fields.description: Ask SSD-capable clients to use compositor decorations.

fields.label: Primary slot
fields.description: Layout selected by the primary layout action.

fields.label: Secondary slot
fields.description: Layout selected by the secondary layout action.

fields.label: Tertiary slot
fields.description: Layout selected by the tertiary layout action.

fields.label: Quaternary slot
fields.description: Layout selected by the quaternary layout action.

fields.label: Scrolling column width
fields.description: Fraction of usable output width for each column.

fields.label: Center focused column
fields.description: Center the focused column; when disabled, pan minimally so other columns remain visible.

fields.label: Follow new windows
fields.description: Pan when a new window extends the column order.

fields.label: Open new windows to the right
fields.description: Insert new columns immediately after the focused column; overrides portrait stacking.

fields.label: Prefer portrait stacks
fields.description: Add new windows to a vertical column when this scrolling instance is taller than wide.

fields.label: Snap viewport
fields.description: Quantize manual viewport movement to columns.

fields.label: Allow overscroll
fields.description: Permit edge columns beyond the centered bound.

fields.label: Scrolling pointer focus delay
fields.description: Milliseconds the pointer must remain over a scrolling member before keyboard focus follows it; zero is immediate.

fields.label: Dwindle split
fields.description: Fraction assigned to each recursive split.

fields.label: Dwindle start axis
fields.description: Direction of the first recursive split.

fields.label: Reverse dwindle split
fields.description: Fraction assigned to each mirrored recursive split.

fields.label: Reverse dwindle start axis
fields.description: Direction of the first mirrored recursive split.

fields.label: Monocle border
fields.description: Draw the configured border in monocle.

fields.label: Stacking placement
fields.description: Policy used for newly opened freeform windows.

fields.label: Snap threshold
fields.description: Pointer distance from an output edge which activates snapping.

fields.label: Top edge maximizes
fields.description: Use the full usable area when a window reaches the top edge.

fields.label: Focus follows pointer
fields.description: Focus a window when the pointer enters it.

fields.label: Move pointer with focus
fields.description: Move the pointer into newly focused windows, except for pointer interactions. Output navigation still moves the pointer when disabled.

fields.label: Focus new windows
fields.description: Give keyboard focus to a newly opened focusable window.

fields.label: Raise focused windows
fields.description: Raise a freeform window when it receives focus.

fields.label: Focus raise delay
fields.description: Milliseconds to wait before raising a newly focused freeform window.

fields.label: Repeat rate
fields.description: Characters per second; zero disables repeat.

fields.label: Mouse acceleration profile
fields.description: Libinput acceleration profile for mouse devices.

fields.label: Natural touchpad scrolling
fields.description: Move content in the same direction as fingers.

fields.label: Tap to click
fields.description: Use a tap as a primary click.

fields.label: Touchpad click method
fields.description: How physical touchpad clicks map to buttons.

fields.label: Apply displays at startup
fields.description: Apply declarative output policy when Aqueous starts.

fields.label: Apply displays on reload
fields.description: Apply declarative output policy after config reload.

fields.label: Fallback profile
fields.description: Named profile used after a rejected output transaction.

fields.label: Display identity
fields.description: Compatibility identity field retained by Aqueous.

fields.label: Companion layout
fields.description: Layout for companion windows beside the anchor.

fields.label: Fallback layout
fields.description: Layout used when Game Mode has no anchor.

fields.label: Game Mode gap
fields.description: Gap between anchor and companion columns.

fields.label: Launcher command
fields.description: Command run by the start-menu action.

fields.label: Terminal command
fields.description: Command run by the terminal action.

fields.label: Screenshot command
fields.description: Command run by the screenshot action.

fields.label: Lock command
fields.description: Command run by the lock-screen action.

raw_files.wm:
[layout]
default = "floating"
gaps_outer = 0
gaps_inner = 0
[workspace_transition]
enabled = false
[input]
focus_follows_mouse = false
focus_new_windows = true
